working.eyes: original counter-rotating spirals only during active work; approved regular rectangular eyes when inactive
working.aura: animated green code tokens and trails
working.purpose: skills, MCPs, workflows, and coordinated swarms

ultracode.eyes: original counter-rotating spirals during active work; approved regular rectangular eyes during rainbow presentation and completion

aura.meaning: toggle external green code aura; rainbow body animation remains active

workingActive.default: true for working/ultracode; false for normal
workingActive.meaning: False reuses the normal-eye sprite, suppresses the work aura and keeps any rainbow body wave; omitted preserves existing studio/reaction behavior

embedding.details: Set globals before loading film.js. Character-only mode needs no #film canvas, skips brand assets, and does not render the full film. Source PNG files remain unchanged.

filmTimingRule: Intervals include the start and exclude the end. Ready/completed beats and opening/closing signatures use rectangular eyes.
